title: Google Maps Business Finder Input
description: Run Google Maps discovery or single-URL analysis (website/seo).

mode.title: Run Mode
mode.description: Select workflow: business discovery on Google Maps, website analysis, or SEO analysis.

query.title: Business Search Query
query.description: Required when mode is google_maps. Example: coffee shops or plumbers.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location hint for Google Maps mode, for example: New York.

max_results.title: Maximum Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of businesses to return in Google Maps mode.

url.title: Website URL
url.description: Required when mode is website or seo. Enter a full URL including https://

save_json.title: Save JSON (Compatibility)
save_json.description: Compatibility flag from API/CLI payloads. The Actor output is always written to Dataset and OUTPUT record.
